column3: Nick Donovan (Brauner) and Ocee James (Hanks) were two former race car drivers who joined the Los Angeles Police Department as part of the "B.A.D. C.A.T." Squad (a double acronym for "Burglary Auto Detail–Commercial Auto Theft"). Using their superior driving skills, the two mainly saw fit to run the bad guys off the road rather than question them. Their superior, Captain Nathan (Vic Morrow) publicly chastised the two, but privately encouraged their "loose cannon" style. Officer Samantha Jensen (Pfeiffer) would occasionally lend a hand when a more feminine approach was called for. Also seen were Ma (LaWanda Page), who owned a bar which the boys frequented, and Rodney (Jimmie Walker), a former car thief trying to get on the straight and narrow.
